## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d917cfefa770311a0a3d405970caab893c0192b4`
Local-runs: none
Scope: every diff path — `.changeset/29705-studio-state-vocabulary.md`; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PageShell.tsx`, `metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.tsx`, new `metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.stateVocabulary-29705.test.tsx`, `metadata-admin/DirectoryPage.environmentOverlay-12141.test.tsx`, `metadata-admin/PageShell.narrowHeader-12306.test.tsx`, `metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.{artifactTier,cloneToCustomize,readonly,readonlyHeaderBadge}.test.tsx`, `metadata-admin/inspectors/inspectorStrings.studioNamespace-25922.test.ts`, `metadata-admin/metadataAreaHost.gates-28561.test.tsx`, `metadata-admin/packagedItemWriteGate-12169.test.tsx`, `studio-design/FlowStatusDot.test.tsx`; `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts`, `studio/zh.ts` — read against `main`: every `t()` reader of the four retired keys (`DirectoryPage.tsx` L256/292/551–562, `PageShell.tsx` L96–134; none elsewhere), `ui/packages/i18n/package.json` (`./namespaces/studio` export, not private), `metadata-admin/ResourceListPage.tsx` L664–667 (`canCreate`), `studio-design/StudioCustomizeControls.tsx` L74 (`isStudioCustomizeType`), `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts` L297–345 and L384 (`isOverridableMetadataType`), `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts` L962–1183 (which registry rows carry `allowEnvironmentOverlay`), `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` (the `no-migration-prescription` arm and the `OLD_COLUMN_RE`/`NEW_COLUMN_RE` table framing), `ui/scripts/i18n-en-drift-baseline.json` (`designerWaivers: {}`), `.github/workflows/ci.yml` L3618, the Type Check UI job log of this head, card #29705 with the claim, the amendment, the PM re-measure, and os-dev report 6595628406.

Read-only; nothing built or run. Card #29705 (one state vocabulary across the pillars, All metadata and Access), narrowing face.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The narrowing is the four studio-namespace keys the table names, and nothing else.** `engine.badge.readOnly`, `.writable`, `.createOnly` and `engine.directory.writableOnly` leave both packs; on `main` their only `t()` readers are the two files this diff rewrites, and the CI `check:i18n-keys` run on this head resolves every call-site key. `engine.directory.description` keeps its key and loses its two placeholders (the only reader now calls `t`, not `tFormat`, and the `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` render goes with them). Five keys are added in both packs. No locale pack (`TranslationKeys`) moves.
- **One rule, two readers.** `typeStateWord` is the only place a state word is decided; `WritabilityBadge` draws it in the list and item headers, and `TypeTile` now renders `WritabilityBadge` instead of its own three-way badge, so the tile and the headers cannot disagree. `TYPE_STATE_WORD_KEY` maps each word to one existing or new key; `data-state-word` carries the word for tests.
- **The read-only arm matches the doors the Console actually opens.** On a read-only package `customizable` needs `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, `overrideSource !== 'env'` and `isOverridableMetadataType`; every type Studio's Customize door covers (`view`, `dashboard`, `report`, plus `translation`/`email_template` through the area's form editor) is an `allowEnvironmentOverlay: true` registry row and `listed` in the spec's classification, so no type the Console can customize reads Read-only. The accepted deviation (a create-only type on a read-only package reads Read-only) follows from `ResourceListPage`'s `canCreate`, which requires `!host?.readOnly`. The env hatch "opens only the items no package ships", so Read-only is the true word for it on a read-only package.
- **Access is value edits only.** The zh `perm.owd.*`, `engine.studio.settings.sharing*`, `colOwd` and `owd_baseline` values change; no key moves and en is untouched.

### ② Semver level

- `@object-ui/i18n` patch and `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none` → patch is the level the protocol axis gives; the `!` title, the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 marker are present.
- Disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: the honest category here, as on PR #29359 (#28789, the precedent for retiring i18n keys). The studio namespace is a plain `Record<string, string>`, so there is no `<path>#<Symbol>` for `runtime-interface-only` and no export for `runtime-export-retired`. Recorded so the next reviewer does not re-derive it: the `| Removed key | Replacement |` table is read by the gate's header-framed arm only when the second column starts with "Use instead"/"Live replacement"/"now", so "Replacement" keeps the arm closed; the marker's claim ("no t() call in the workspace reads them") is what makes the table a CHANGELOG note rather than a consumer prescription, and that claim is true on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **MUST-FIX — CI is red on this head from this diff.** Type Check UI fails at `pnpm --dir ui run check:i18n-drift` (`ci.yml` L3618, not one of the 35 derived dispatch-gates families, which is why the sweep was green): two designer-table en values changed without their zh row — `ENGINE_STRINGS.engine.studio.auto.off` ("Off" → "Switched off") and `ENGINE_STRINGS.engine.studio.auto.offTitle` ("Disabled — will not run" → "Switched off — will not run"). zh already reads 已停用 / 已停用 — 不会运行, which is the new en's meaning, so the fix is two `designerWaivers` entries in `ui/scripts/i18n-en-drift-baseline.json` (`{ "en": "<new text verbatim>", "reason": "…", "issue": "objectstack#29705" }`), not a zh edit. The gate's own message spells the shape. The remaining CI runs were in progress (10 success, 11 skipped, 30 in progress, 1 failure) when this was written.
- Should-fix, one line, in the same push: `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` L847's `tFormat` docstring example still reads `tFormat('engine.directory.description', 'zh-CN', { count: 28, writable: 4 })`; that key no longer takes those placeholders. Pick any key that still does.
- `Fixes #29705` closes the card; the Access row the PM re-measure put in scope is answered by the zh value edits, and the five leftovers are filed as #29729 in the body.
- The studio packs are also edited by seat 5's own #29704 (PR #29780, different keys) and seat 1's #29691 (PR #29723); the dev merged main at `e82bf642`. Re-merge before enqueueing if either lands first.

### ④ Design judgment

- One word per state, decided once and drawn everywhere, is the right shape for this card, and taking the words from the pillars (not inventing a fifth spelling) is what makes it one vocabulary. "Can be customized" on a read-only package replaces the one reading that was a contradiction (可写 on 只读).
- The tile's word answers "what can I do here" for the Console's doors, not for the spec's classification: `page`, `app`, `flow` and `action` are `overridable` in the spec but not overlay rows, so they read Read-only on a read-only package. That is the true answer today, because no Console door customizes them. When the Customize door grows to one of them, the `allowEnvironmentOverlay` term in `typeStateWord` is the line to revisit; worth a sentence in that helper's comment, not a change now.
- Narrowing face: the four retired keys were engine-facing rows nobody outside the two rewritten files read; a consumer narrowing is right here because the surface it removes was the second spelling the card exists to remove, and the BREAKING table names where each word now lives.

One must-fix (③, the drift gate). One should-fix (③, the docstring). ①, ② and ④ hold and will carry over to the fixed head; a delta re-review of that head is the next step.
